risks.proof: Video of the engine running or compression/leak-down test results

risks.risk: Missing accessories, ECU, wiring harness, or other components
risks.proof: Photo showing the complete engine with all components attached

risks.risk: Wrong Porsche engine model or code for the buyer's vehicle

response.reason: The specific Porsche engine model is unreadable in the photos, and engine value depends heavily on the exact model, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without it.
